errors.evidence: The description of the red 'Precision' line is misleading. While the start (~78%) and end (~77%) values are similar, the trend is not steady. The line shows a significant dip to approximately 70% at the 410m model size before rising again.
The description fails to mention the marker shapes for any of the three lines (all are triangles), which was an explicit requirement of the generation prompt.
The starting value for the blue 'Recall' line at the 70m model size is visibly below 10%, closer to 8%.
The description fails to mention the line style (solid) for any of the lines, which was requested in the prompt.
